t: Our Story — Wheat Montana
s: The business continued to expand, to include cereal, seeds, and pancake mixes, and the company began shipping something close to 150 different products to stores, restaurants, and other outlets all across the country. More Wheat Montana delis were opened in various locations around the state, and the company soon came to employ over 150 people, most of whom live in Montana.
